Package io.github.janglada.orkit.routing

Class VehicleConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.janglada.orkit.routing.VehicleConfig
public final class VehicleConfig extends Object
Fluent configurator for a vehicle, used inside the lambda passed to RoutingBuilder.vehicle(String, java.util.function.Consumer).

  • Method Details

    • capacity

      public VehicleConfig capacity(long units)
      Sets the vehicle's carrying capacity in the default "load" dimension, in the units of StopConfig.demand(long); default unlimited.

    • capacity

      public VehicleConfig capacity(String dimension, long units)
      Sets the vehicle's capacity in a named dimension (for example "kg" or "pallets"), matched against StopConfig.demand(String, long). A dimension this vehicle does not declare is unbounded for it.

    • maxDistanceMeters

      public VehicleConfig maxDistanceMeters(long meters)
      Caps the total distance this vehicle may travel; default 0 means no cap.

    • startsAt

      public VehicleConfig startsAt(String depotId)
      Assigns this vehicle to depart from the given depot. When endsAt(String) is not also set, the vehicle returns to this same depot. If neither startsAt nor endsAt is called, the vehicle uses the default (first) depot for both ends.
      Parameters:
      depotId - id of a depot registered via RoutingBuilder.depot(String, double, double)
      Throws:
      ModelException - if depotId is blank

    • endsAt

      public VehicleConfig endsAt(String depotId)
      Assigns this vehicle to return to the given depot. When startsAt(String) is not also set, the vehicle departs from this same depot. If neither startsAt nor endsAt is called, the vehicle uses the default (first) depot for both ends.
      Parameters:
      depotId - id of a depot registered via RoutingBuilder.depot(String, double, double)
      Throws:
      ModelException - if depotId is blank

    • availableFrom

      public VehicleConfig availableFrom(LocalTime time)
      Earliest time-of-day the vehicle may leave its start depot; default 00:00. Turns the time dimension on, so arrival times are then reported on the route.

    • availableUntil

      public VehicleConfig availableUntil(LocalTime time)
      Latest time-of-day the vehicle must be back at its end depot; default end of day.

    • maxRouteDuration

      public VehicleConfig maxRouteDuration(Duration duration)
      Caps the route duration (end-depot arrival minus start-depot departure), which counts driving, service, and waiting time.

    • fixedCost

      public VehicleConfig fixedCost(long cost)
      Cost charged once when this vehicle serves at least one stop; default 0. Same units as meters, so it is reported in RoutingPlan.objective() under Goals.totalCost(). Idle vehicles pay nothing.

    • skills

      public VehicleConfig skills(String... skills)
      Capabilities of this vehicle (for example "refrigerated"), matched against StopConfig.requires(String...).

    • breakBetween

      public VehicleConfig breakBetween(LocalTime earliest, LocalTime latest, Duration duration)
      Requires a driver break of duration starting no earlier than earliest and ending no later than latest. The break may interrupt a drive between two stops (never a service), or fall before the route starts or after it ends. Repeatable; turns the time dimension on.
      Throws:
      ModelException - if an argument is null, the duration is not positive, or the break does not fit between earliest and latest

    • costPerMeter

      public VehicleConfig costPerMeter(long cost)
      Cost per meter driven under Goals.totalCost(); default 1, so meters and cost coincide unless set. Other goals measure plain meters.

    • costPerMinute

      public VehicleConfig costPerMinute(long cost)
      Cost per minute of route duration (start-depot departure to end-depot arrival, waiting included) under Goals.totalCost(); default 0. Turns the time dimension on.
